mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies and 54 degrees at Harriet Park with a waxing gibbous moon, plus an air quality alert remains in effect.
The city is currently processing the 2027 annual budget, and the Plan Commission is scheduled to meet on November 4 to review projects like the Ardent Glen third addition.
There is plenty to do with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company happening today, plus the Dane County Farmer's Market tomorrow.
On October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after reports of dangerous driving, though no injuries were reported.
Today's flavor of the day is Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie, and the store will be ready to serve you when it opens today at 10:00 AM.
